resolution_rules: Each semicolon-delimited location item is resolved independently after surrounding whitespace is removed.
Items beginning with src/, public/, or tests/ are relative to source.web_root (apps/web); all other filesystem items are repository-root-relative.
A trailing :<positive integer> is a one-based source line, while a #/... suffix on docs/api/openapi-v1.yaml is a JSON Pointer.
HTTPS locations are absolute runtime evidence; dated architecture-decision labels are non-filesystem evidence.

evidence.detail: All migrated routes, page components, shared state/mutations, scheduling, integrations, PWA files, and supporting domain utilities under apps/web were inventoried.
The first-party v1 API contract and current architecture/capability documentation were mapped to Android responsibilities.
The interactive Android prototype and Kotlin/Compose handoff were audited completely, including flows, assets, API mapping, and acceptance checklist.
The deployed signed-out experience was inspected: previews, providers, legal links, theme, and support widget. Authenticated runtime was unavailable.
Existing web tests under apps/web were inspected for contract and edge-case evidence; the original capability audit did not execute them.

exclusions.justification: Historical React Native/Expo concepts are inspiration only; the current web source, v1 API, and prototypes/android/v1 are authoritative.

exclusions.scope: Non-product developer tooling and deployment administration
exclusions.justification: CI provider setup and web hosting internals are not end-user Android capabilities; Android build/release security remains in scope.

limitations.impact: Authenticated screens and real provider exchanges were not dynamically exercised; source, OpenAPI, tests, and prototype evidence were used.
limitations.next_action: Run the release parity matrix against a staging account for Google and Microsoft before verification.

limitations.impact: The full web unit/API suite passes (32 files, 117 tests), including scheduled/unrecorded analytics parity, and the targeted backend-alignment suite passes; database-backed Playwright/OAuth/preview deployment remain environment gates.

limitations.impact: The Compose application, typed v1 client, account-bound encrypted session/cache, adaptive navigation, all feature surfaces, scheduled/unrecorded analytics, validated backup flows, notification routing, unit tests, lint, debug assembly, and minified release assembly are implemented.
